name: Slider
summary: A number picked by sliding along a track. It is a native range input, so the drag, the steps and the value are the platform's.
summaryZh: 沿着轨道滑出来的一个数值。它是原生的 range 输入框,拖动、步进和取值都由平台负责。

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The thumb is smaller and the track is the thin one.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The thumb is bigger and the track is the thick one.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The cursor becomes not-allowed and the control leaves the tab order.

states.name: Vertical
states.note: The slider stands on its end. The browser lays a range input out along the writing mode, so the vertical writing mode is the whole of it.

states.name: Show stops
states.note: The track carries the tick marks that say there is a scale along it. They are evenly spaced, because a stylesheet cannot count the steps.

props.name: min
props.description: The lowest value the slider accepts.

props.name: max
props.description: The highest value the slider accepts.

props.name: step
props.description: How much one arrow key press moves the value.
props.descriptionZh: 按一次方向键,数值移动多少。

props.name: value
props.description: The current value. It is written to the value attribute, so it round-trips through a form.
props.descriptionZh: 当前值。它写在 value 属性上,所以能随表单提交再回来。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the slider inert. It uses the real disabled attribute, so it leaves the tab order.
props.descriptionZh: 让滑块不可用。它用的是原生 disabled 属性,因此会退出 Tab 顺序。

props.name: vertical
props.description: Stands the slider on its end, so the value runs from the bottom up.
props.descriptionZh: 把滑块立起来,数值从下往上走。

props.name: size
props.description: How big the thumb is and how thick the track is. The middle size is the base class on its own; the small size adds um-slider--sm and the large size adds um-slider--lg.
props.descriptionZh: 滑块多大、轨道多粗。中间那一档是只写基类;小号加上 um-slider--sm,大号加上 um-slider--lg。

props.name: show-stops
props.description: Whether the track carries the tick marks that say there is a scale along it. They are evenly spaced, so they say that there is a scale rather than where it breaks. It adds um-slider--show-stops.
props.descriptionZh: 轨道上是否画出那些说明这里有刻度的记号。这些记号是等距的,所以它们说明这里有刻度,而不是刻度在哪里断开。它加上 um-slider--show-stops。

props.name: model-value
props.description: The slider's own value, bound with v-model in Vue. Leave it out and the `value` prop is the value; bind it and the slider answers to the binding.
props.descriptionZh: 滑块自身的数值,在 Vue 里用 v-model 绑定。不传就以 value 属性为准;传了就以绑定为准。

events.name: input
events.description: Fires while the value is being dragged or stepped. It is the browser's own event — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 拖动或按方向键改变数值时持续触发。这是浏览器自己的事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the value is committed, at the end of a drag or when focus leaves the control.
events.descriptionZh: 数值被提交时触发:拖动结束时,或者焦点离开控件时。

events.name: update:modelValue
events.description: Fires when the value changes, carrying the new value. This is the event `v-model` listens to.
events.descriptionZh: 值变化时触发,携带新的值。v-model 监听的就是这个事件。

a11y.notes: A real <input type="range">: the browser owns the drag, the arrow keys, Home and End, and the announcement of the value. The track and the thumb are painted through the vendor pseudo-elements, so the control has no child elements and no markup of its own to keep in sync.
a11y.notesZh: 这是一个真正的 <input type="range">:拖动、方向键、Home 和 End、以及数值的播报都由浏览器负责。轨道和滑块是用各浏览器的伪元素画出来的,所以这个控件没有子元素,也没有一份需要同步的标记。

examples.title: A range
examples.description: The bounds and the step are plain attributes. Whatever the browser shows for the value — the tooltip on some platforms — is not painted by the library, because that popup belongs to the platform.
examples.descriptionZh: 上下限和步进都是普通属性。至于浏览器怎么显示当前值 —— 有些平台会弹一个小窗 —— 库不去画它,那个浮层属于平台。
examples.markup: <input class="um-slider" type="range" aria-label="Value" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="60" />

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled slider uses the real disabled attribute, so it is skipped by the tab order rather than only looking disabled.
examples.descriptionZh: 禁用的滑块用的是原生 disabled 属性,所以它是被 Tab 顺序跳过,而不只是看起来禁用了。
examples.markup: <input class="um-slider" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="60" disabled />

notes: The track is drawn twice, once for the WebKit pseudo-element and once for the Firefox one, and the thumb the same way. That duplication is the price of styling a native control: there is no single standard pseudo-element for either, so both engines get the same geometry instead of one of them getting the default.
notesZh: 轨道写了两遍,WebKit 的伪元素一份、Firefox 的一份,滑块同样如此。这就是给原生控件改样式的代价:两者都没有单一的通用伪元素,所以两种引擎拿到的是同一套几何尺寸,而不是其中一个保持默认。
